deviationsFromSpec.verifiedFact: hasActiveTree has exactly one caller, resync.ts:278 (grep over packages/daemon/src); packages/daemon/tsconfig.json sets noUnusedLocals: true, so an uncalled hasActiveTree fails tsc
deviationsFromSpec.decision: hasActiveTree is deleted, not widened; no other caller exists so no other semantics change. The gate reads trees[key].status directly because reportRootAnomalies already skips every child at line 250, so the parent-chain walk never advanced for this caller.
